subject: Summary: FastPay service impact, root cause, and next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@fastpay.com>, FastPay Ops <ops@fastpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Summary: FastPay service impact, root cause, and next steps

Hi Julia / FastPay team,

Thanks again for the patience while we investigated Friday's partial availability incident. Below is a concise, customer-facing summary of what happened, the immediate mitigations we put in place, and our committed remediation plan. I attached a PDF with a slightly more detailed timeline and logs relevant to your account.

Executive summary
- Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors for inference requests to the dedicated pool backing your FastPay-production model, affecting ~12% of requests between 03:14–03:42 PDT on 2027-06-11.
- Customer-visible symptoms: elevated latency and spikes of 502/503 responses; retries caused a small number of duplicate events.
- Root cause (short): a coordination bug in our autoscaler that triggered a rapid resize of the dedicated GPU pool while in-flight KV-cache eviction was ongoing, which returned a transient error state for a subset of model shards.

Timeline (high level)
- 03:10 PDT: background rolling update of a runtime patch began (scheduled maintenance window overlap).
- 03:14 PDT: autoscaler observed a CPU/queue metric anomaly and started scale-down of one node.
- 03:16–03:22 PDT: scale-down raced with our KV-cache invalidation; some shards reported cache-miss exceptions leading to 502s.
- 03:22 PDT: automatic fallback routed ~70% of requests to a compatible model replica; errors reduced.
- 03:42 PDT: autoscaler stabilized, and full capacity restored.

Immediate mitigations taken by Redwood
- Rolled back the recent runtime patch and disabled the autoscale rule that triggered the rapid downscale.
- Enabled conservative cache eviction gating so in-flight KV caches finish before node removal.
- Increased redundant replica routing for your pool to reduce single-node reliance.

Committed next steps & owners (ETA)
- Evelyn: Deploy a hard gate in the autoscaler to prevent scale-down while cache-eviction jobs are active (by 2027-06-18).
- Marissa: Provide a post-deployment validation checklist and coordinate a short rehearse window with your ops (by 2027-06-15).
- Aditya: Share a detailed customer-facing RCA document with logs and a remediation ledger (attached) and propose a follow-up sync to discuss credits/impact (by 2027-06-14).

Attachments: redwood-fastpay-20270612-rca-summary.pdf (PDF) — contains the full timeline, error-rate graphs for your routes, and relevant trace IDs.

Ask from you
- Please confirm whether the duplicate events you saw are limited to the time window above and if you would like us to open a forensic review on specific trace IDs.
- Let me know a 30-min window next week for a follow-up with Evelyn and Marissa.

We're sorry for the disruption — keeping FastPay stable is our top priority.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@fastpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: FastPay Ops <ops@fastpay.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summary: FastPay service impact, root cause, and next steps

Thanks Aditya — clear and helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications before the sync: 

1) Can you confirm whether the duplicate events we observed were produced by client-side retries or server-side replay? Our preliminary logs show retries from our SDK around 03:18 PDT but there are still a small number of duplicates outside those retry windows.

2) You mention "compatible model replica" routing — can you confirm whether those replicas were cold-started and whether that contributed to added latency for some requests?

We'd also appreciate a short note on what you'd recommend for immediate client-side mitigations (retry backoff adjustments, idempotency keys) to reduce user impact while you complete the autoscaler fix.

Available for a 30-min sync Monday 2027-06-14 between 08:30–11:00 PDT.

—Julia
Julia Ramos
Sr. Platform Engineer, FastPay
julia.ramos@fastpay.com

- Evelyn: Confirm whether the "compatible replica" routing caused cold-start latency for any subset and whether we need a warm-up path for that pool.
- Marissa: Draft recommended client-side mitigations (short note) — specifically suggested retry/backoff window and idempotency guidance — to include for Julia in the sync.

Commitments: 
- Evelyn: I want a short write-up on the cache-eviction gating patch and the expected validation plan by EOD Monday (2027-06-14).
- Marissa: Please schedule the 30-min customer sync for Monday 06/14 at 09:30 PDT if Julia confirms — send calendar invite and include meeting notes template.
- Aditya: I'll prepare the credits/impact proposal for exec review and include that in Monday's sync agenda.

I'll attach the internal workitem CSV with owner columns to track.

Thanks — let's close the loop quickly.

Aditya
